# Arcadia Drywall

> Drywall, Texture & Paint in St. George, UT. Ramon and the Arcadia crew fix drywall, match the texture and paint around St. George, from leak and flood damage to new homes. Customers say the repair blends in and the space is left cleaner than they found it.

Note: this is a preview site built by Handled (handleditforyou.com), not yet the business's live website.

## Services
- Drywall repair: Holes, cracks and cut-outs patched so you can't tell it was a repair.
- Texture & paint match: Texture and paint matched to what was there before.
- Water & flood damage: Ceilings and walls rebuilt after a leak or a flood, mold areas cleaned and repaired.
- New homes & whole-house paint: Hanging, taping and mudding for builders, and whole houses painted.

## Service area
- St. George, UT

## Questions customers ask
- **Can you match my texture and paint?** Customers say yes. One said the texture and paint match is done perfectly, leaving no evidence of a previous issue.
- **Do you fix water and flood damage?** Yes. One customer had a flood and a big hole cut in the wall. The drywall came back perfect, with an access panel added for next time.
- **Do you paint whole houses?** Yes. One customer had Ramon paint their entire house, and used him for their office too.
- **Do you work with builders?** Yes. Builders and general contractors say they use Arcadia for drywall and paint on new homes.
- **What areas do you serve?** We serve St. George and surrounding Washington County. Not sure if you're in range? Give us a call.
